prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Pet Controls", "Try Your Pet Controls", "Practice hiding, dragging, and speaking with your companion so you are ready on your desktop.", "Start Desktop Pet", "Interactive Pet Simulator", "Drag pet to move | Double-click to open chat | Press Esc to hide"]
1: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select a desktop pet character to accompany your daily workflow.", "Select Companion Character"]
2: ["Customize Pet Habits While Waiting", "Set sleep hours and desktop movement preferences while your pet is generated.", "Save Habits", "Pet Desk Activity Level"]
3: ["Save Your Companion Choice", "Sign in to bind your chosen pet to your account and prevent progress loss."]
4: ["Generating Your Pet", "We will play a pleasant sound when your companion is ready for your desktop.", "Enable Ready Chime"]
5: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original email to keep your existing desktop pet."]
6: ["Choose Your Pet Experience", "Select a path to unlock a free starter accessory for your desktop companion.", "Includes Free Starter Toy Pack"]
7: ["Protect Your Pet's Memory", "Sign in to securely sync your companion's level, accessories, and personality to the cloud."]
8: ["Estimated creation time: ~2 minutes. Feel free to minimize the window.", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
9: ["Explore Companion Capabilities", "Discover how your pet will assist you on screen while working or studying.", "Continue Setup", "Desk Companion Features: Break Reminders, Interactive Reactions, Desktop Widgets"]
